title: 迷神引·一叶扁舟轻帆卷
title_en: To the Tune Mi Shen Yin: A Leaf of a Boat, Its Light Sail Furled
author: 柳永

form.en: ci lyric, long form in two stanzas

text_note.zh: 原始资料作“胡茄”，是“胡笳”的错字，这里改正。
text_note.en: The source text has a wrong character for jiā in hú jiā (the reed pipe); it is corrected here.

readings.zh: “扁舟”的“扁”读 piān，意思是小。不读 biǎn。
readings.en: In piān zhōu (small boat), the character is read piān, meaning small, not biǎn.
Here the character means to moor a boat and is read bó, not pō.
In mù jiǎo (evening horn), it means a bugle horn and is read jiǎo.

readings.zh: “赊”这里读 shē，意思是远，不是“赊账”的意思。
readings.en: Read shē. Here it means far away, not buying on credit.

glosses.zh: 一叶扁舟：一只小船，小得像一片树叶。
glosses.en: yī yè piān zhōu: a small boat, as small as a leaf.

glosses.zh: 轻帆卷：把轻轻的船帆收卷起来，准备停船。
glosses.en: qīng fān juǎn: rolling up the light sail, ready to stop.

glosses.zh: 暂泊：暂时停船靠岸。
glosses.en: zàn bó: to stop the boat at the shore for a while.

glosses.zh: 楚江：流过古代楚国一带的江，指长江中游。
glosses.en: chǔ jiāng: the river through the old land of Chu, the middle Yangtze.

glosses.zh: 暮角：傍晚城楼上吹响的号角。
glosses.en: mù jiǎo: the horn blown on the city wall at dusk.

glosses.zh: 胡笳：从北方民族传来的一种吹奏乐器，声音悲凉。
glosses.en: hú jiā: a reed pipe from the northern peoples, with a sad sound.

glosses.zh: 怨：哀怨的声音。
glosses.en: yuàn: a sorrowful sound.

glosses.zh: 平沙：平坦的沙滩。
glosses.en: píng shā: a flat sandbank.

glosses.zh: 旋：随即，很快地。
glosses.en: xuán: at once, quickly.

glosses.zh: 烟敛：烟雾收起、散开了。
glosses.en: yān liǎn: the mist draws back and clears.

glosses.zh: 簇：聚在一起，一丛一丛的。
glosses.en: cù: gathered in clumps.

glosses.zh: 画屏展：像一扇画屏风打开在眼前。
glosses.en: huà píng zhǎn: like a painted screen opened up in front of you.

glosses.zh: 天际：天边。
glosses.en: tiān jì: the edge of the sky.

glosses.zh: 黛眉：女子用青黑色颜料画的眉毛。这里用来比远处淡淡的山。
glosses.en: dài méi: a woman's eyebrows painted dark blue-black. Here it stands for faint far hills.

glosses.zh: 旧赏：从前的游乐和欢乐生活。
glosses.en: jiù shǎng: the pleasures and good times of the past.

glosses.zh: 轻抛：轻易地丢下了。
glosses.en: qīng pāo: lightly thrown away.

glosses.zh: 游宦：离开家乡，到外地做官。
glosses.en: yóu huàn: leaving home to serve as an official in faraway places.

glosses.zh: 客程：在外漂泊的旅程。
glosses.en: kè chéng: the journey of a traveler far from home.

glosses.zh: 年光晚：年纪已经大了。
glosses.en: nián guāng wǎn: the years are getting late; one is growing old.

glosses.zh: 风物：风景和事物。
glosses.en: fēng wù: the scenery and the things of a place.

glosses.zh: 忍：怎么忍心，哪里受得了。
glosses.en: rěn: how can one bear it.

glosses.zh: 萧索：冷清、凄凉。
glosses.en: xiāo suǒ: bleak and lonely.

glosses.zh: 当愁眼：正对着满含愁苦的眼睛。
glosses.en: dāng chóu yǎn: right in front of sad eyes.

glosses.zh: 帝城：京城，指北宋都城汴京。
glosses.en: dì chéng: the capital, here Bianjing, the Northern Song capital.

glosses.zh: 秦楼：本指秦穆公女儿弄玉住的楼，后来常指心爱女子住的地方。
glosses.en: qín lóu: first the tower of Nongyu, daughter of Duke Mu of Qin; later, the home of a beloved woman.

glosses.zh: 阻：隔开，去不了。
glosses.en: zǔ: cut off, cannot be reached.

glosses.zh: 旅魂：旅人的心思。
glosses.en: lǚ hún: the traveler's heart and mind.

glosses.zh: 连空阔：一直连到空旷的远方。
glosses.en: lián kōng kuò: stretching all the way into the open distance.

glosses.zh: 残照：快要落山的夕阳光。
glosses.en: cán zhào: the last light of the setting sun.

glosses.zh: 断云：一片片断开的云。
glosses.en: duàn yún: broken pieces of cloud.

translation.zh: 一只小船像片树叶，收起了轻轻的帆，
translation.en: My boat, small as a leaf, rolls up its light sail,

translation.zh: 暂时停在楚江的南岸。
translation.en: and stops for a while on the south bank of the Chu River.

translation.zh: 孤零零的城上，傍晚吹起了号角，
translation.en: On the lonely city wall the evening horn sounds,

translation.zh: 引出胡笳哀怨的声音。
translation.en: and draws out the sad tune of the reed pipe.

translation.zh: 江水茫茫一片，
translation.en: The water spreads wide and dim.

translation.zh: 平平的沙滩上落着大雁，
translation.en: Wild geese rest on the flat sandbank,

translation.zh: 一下子被惊得四散飞走。
translation.en: and in a moment they are startled and scatter.

translation.zh: 烟雾散开，冷落的树林一丛丛，
translation.en: The mist clears; the cold woods stand in clumps,

translation.zh: 像一扇画屏在眼前展开。
translation.en: like a painted screen opened up before me.

translation.zh: 天边远处的山显得很小，
translation.en: Far hills at the sky's edge look small,

translation.zh: 像女子画的眉毛一样淡淡的。
translation.en: faint as a woman's painted eyebrows.

translation.zh: 从前的欢乐生活，被我轻易丢下，
translation.en: I lightly threw away the pleasures of the past,

translation.zh: 到如今成了在外地做官的人。
translation.en: and now I have become an official wandering far from home.

translation.zh: 只觉得旅途辛苦，
translation.en: I feel how tiring the road is,

translation.zh: 自己的年纪也已经大了。
translation.en: and how late in life I have grown.

translation.zh: 他乡的风景和事物，
translation.en: The sights of this strange place,

translation.zh: 这么冷清，叫人怎么受得了，
translation.en: so bleak, how can I bear them,

translation.zh: 偏偏正对着我发愁的眼睛。
translation.en: right in front of my sad eyes?

translation.zh: 京城那么遥远，
translation.en: The capital is far away,

translation.zh: 心上人住的地方也被隔开了，
translation.en: the home of the one I love is cut off from me,

translation.zh: 我这个旅人心里乱成一团。
translation.en: and my traveling heart is all in turmoil.

translation.zh: 芳草一直连到空旷的远方，
translation.en: Sweet grass stretches out to the open distance,

translation.zh: 夕阳的余光洒满了大地。
translation.en: and the last sunlight fills everything.

translation.zh: 心爱的人没有一点消息，
translation.en: From my love there is no word,

translation.zh: 只有断开的云彩飘向远方。
translation.en: only broken clouds drifting far away.

background.zh: 这首词写的是作者在外地做官、坐船赶路时的心情。从“楚江南岸”看，地点在长江中游一带，古代属于楚地。柳永中年以后才考中进士，此后在各地做小官，常年奔波。这首词具体是哪一年写的，现在说不清楚。词里说“到此成游宦”，又说“年光晚”，可以看出是他年纪较大、在外漂泊时写的。
background.en: This lyric shows how the poet felt while traveling by boat as an official far from home. The words "south bank of the Chu River" place it on the middle Yangtze, the old land of Chu. Liu Yong passed the top exam only in middle age, and after that he served as a minor official in many places, always on the move. We do not know which year this poem was written. It says he has become a wandering official and that his years are growing late, so it comes from a time when he was older and far from home.

author_note.zh: 柳永（约987—约1053），北宋词人，原名三变，福建崇安人。他年轻时常在京城的歌楼里写词，写得通俗好懂，传唱很广，人们说“凡有井水饮处，即能歌柳词”。他很晚才考中进士，一生只做过小官。他特别擅长写长调慢词，常写离别和羁旅的愁苦。
author_note.en: Liu Yong (about 987 to about 1053) was a Northern Song lyric poet from Chong'an in Fujian. His first name was Sanbian. When young he wrote songs for the singing houses of the capital. They were easy to understand and spread everywhere; people said that wherever there was a well, people sang Liu Yong's songs. He passed the exam late and only held small posts. He was a master of long, slow lyrics, often about partings and the sorrows of travel.

appreciation.zh: 上片写景。一只小船停在江边，傍晚城上响起号角和胡笳，声音悲凉。沙滩上的大雁被惊飞，天边的远山淡得像女子的眉毛。景色像画一样美，却又冷清孤单。下片写情。作者说自己丢下了从前快乐的日子，成了到处奔波的小官，人也老了。他乡的景色越萧索，他越难受。京城远，心上人也见不到，心里一团乱。结尾又回到景色：芳草连天，夕阳洒满，只有断云飘远。这几句不直接说想念，却把想念写得又长又远，像那片望不到头的芳草。
appreciation.en: The first stanza paints the scene. A small boat stops by the river. At dusk a horn and a reed pipe sound from the city wall, sad and thin. Geese on the sandbank are startled into the air, and far hills are as faint as a woman's eyebrows. The view is pretty as a painting, but cold and lonely. The second stanza turns to feeling. The poet says he threw away his happy past and became a minor official always on the road, and now he is old. The bleaker the strange land looks, the worse he feels. The capital is far, he cannot see the one he loves, and his heart is in a tangle. The ending goes back to the view: grass running to the sky, the last sunlight everywhere, and broken clouds drifting away. These lines never say "I miss her", yet they make the missing feel long and endless, like grass that runs past the edge of sight.
